fact: Le Matinal reports the Conseil des ministres created the Registre Social Unique, an information system for eligibility decisions and household data, described as a system 'en cours de mise en place'.
ANIP/WURI-Benin reports a launch and scoping workshop was opened for setting up the Registre Social Unique, financed by the World Bank WURI project and due to be effective in six months.

The social affairs ministry opened the kick-off workshop for building the Registre Social Unique, World Bank-financed through WURI, with a DW/Technologies Wevioo/Stratec-ARC consortium and completion due in six months.
